preconditions.expression: isinstance(N, int) and isinstance(M, int) and 3 <= N <= 200000 and 1 <= M <= 200000
preconditions.description: N and M are integers within the specified constraints.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == N - 1 and all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: There are exactly N-1 edges, and all vertices in edges are within the range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N and 1 <= q <= N and degree[p] >= 2 for p, q in queries)
preconditions.description: For every query (P, Q), P and Q are valid vertices, and P is not a leaf (degree >= 2).
The edges form a valid tree structure (connected, acyclic).

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly M lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(line), int) and int(line) >= 2 for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer representing a valid sequence length (at least 2, since P != Q or P=Q with length 2 is possible if self-loop logic applies, but strictly P1->P2 requires length >= 2).

postconditions.expression: all(is_max_cool_length(N, edges, p, q, ans) for (p, q), ans in zip(queries, [int(line) for line in output_lines]))
postconditions.description: For each query (P, Q), the output value X is the maximum integer such that there exists a sequence A of length X where A[0]=P, A[X-1]=Q, and for all 1 <= i < X, dist(A[i-1], A[i]) == i.
